Info

Defines IBinaryActuatorFrameBuilder protocol for tool and motor actuation frame construction.

class scaralang.core.service.protocol.iactuator_builder.IBinaryActuatorFrameBuilder(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: Protocol

Structural protocol defining actuator binary frame construction contracts.

It defines:

methods:
build_tool_cmd - Builds a tool actuation command frame.
build_motor_config_cmd - Builds a motor configuration command frame.
get_version - Returns actuator frame builder version string.
_abc_impl = <_abc._abc_data object>¶
_is_protocol = True¶
_is_runtime_protocol = True¶
build_motor_config_cmd(*, seq_num: int, mode: int, axis_mask: int = AxisMask.ALL) → BinaryFrame[source]¶

Builds a motor actuation mode configuration frame.

Parameters:

  • seq_num – Cyclic sequence index.

  • mode – Motor drive mode integer (0=OPEN_LOOP, 1=CLOSED_LOOP).

  • axis_mask – Bitmask of target axes (default AxisMask.ALL).

Returns:

Assembled motor configuration BinaryFrame.

build_tool_cmd(*, seq_num: int, tool_id: int, state: bool) → BinaryFrame[source]¶

Builds a tool actuation command frame (PUMP, VALVE).

Parameters:

  • seq_num – Cyclic sequence index.

  • tool_id – Tool identifier (0=PUMP, 1=VALVE).

  • state – True to activate, False to deactivate.

Returns:

Assembled tool command BinaryFrame.

Returns component version string.

Returns:

Semantic version string.
